pages.text: Where Finality ends, Origin begins. Roger Penrose noticed that at the end of a heat death only massless particles remain - and light has no clock: it cannot tell an infinitely large, cold universe from a tiny, hot one. Rescale the dead universe's infinite future and it is the Big Bang of the next $(thing)aeon$().

In the $(item)Inflation Chamber$(): $(item)Heat Death Embers$(), a $(item)De Sitter Horizon Shard$() and $(fluid)Dark Era Haze$() make an $(item)Aeon Boundary Shard$(); the Shard with a $(item)No-Boundary Seed$() and inflaton condensate makes two $(item)Universe Seeds$(). A $(item)Bounce Core$() from a Big Crunch makes one too.

Origin also feeds what came before it: the $(item)Universe Forge$() can make a $(item)Pocket Universe$() from first principles - a seed, a true-vacuum bubble, the asymmetry, the ash and the plasma - and the Eye of the Horizon's and the Omnilex's universes now want Primordial Ash and a No-Boundary Seed.
